expected_execution_change: Holding the parent dose and weights fixed and varying only native_options.cat_noise_level to 0.25, the expected measurable change is an increase in joint_formation above the R06 level of 0.083 and a corresponding increase in joint_at_integration above 0.167, with retention_after_formation reported only for runs where formation is nonzero. Because lower categorical transition noise should reduce suffix identity switching during native generation, boundary_N_probability at slot 12 is expected to rise above the R06 value of 0.204 while boundary_C_probability at slot 22 remains high near 0.977. Terminal readouts to report are joint_formation, retention_after_formation, boundary_N_probability, boundary_C_probability, and mean_pic50 against the R06 parent (mean 7.675, best 8.049) and matched unguided controls at the same dose; final_prediction_changed_typed_fraction should be reported as a quality side effect. Region discovery remains fixed during this frozen calibration.
falsifier: If matched unguided controls at cat_noise_level 0.25 show equal or higher joint_formation and retention_after_formation than the guided L110 run at 0.25, then reduced categorical noise is not the driver of any formation or retention change. Second falsifier: if joint_formation remains at or below the R06 level of 0.083 at cat_noise_level 0.25, the hypothesis that reduced categorical noise raises formation is not supported. These falsifiers concern measured generation and terminal outputs, not immutable patch metadata or source labels.
scientific_rationale: L110 is a legal local_nc_layout patch on F_b011_s030_best_legal with typed slots 12 (desired N, native C) and 22 (desired C, native N); both sites are neutral degree-two pyridine-type aromatic N / aromatic CH, so the requested N/C exchange is chemically admissible and no pyrrole [nH] or amide N is involved. The parent R06 run at cat_noise_level 1.0 produced joint_formation 0.083 and joint_at_integration 0.167 with boundary_N_probability 0.204, i.e. the N target at slot 12 is poorly supported and formation is the limiting step; R05 at the same noise produced joint_formation 0.0 with retention null because formation was absent, not because retention was measured and lost. native_options.cat_noise_level is categorical transition noise applied during native generation, including the suffix, and per parameter_semantics it does not overwrite or freeze labels; it therefore acts on the generation/formation channel rather than on the direct type-gradient coefficient. Reducing it from 1.0 to 0.25 is a directionally defensible, untested dose that should reduce stochastic categorical transitions away from the desired suffix identities and thus raise joint_formation, with retention_after_formation only interpretable once formation is nonzero. V00 is selected over V01 because 0.25 is the stronger test of the noise-reduction direction while remaining a legal, registered variant; the parent dose (max_atom_step_A 0.15, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0, native_rms_ratio 0.66, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0) and weights (endpoint 0, half 0.7, orientation 0, pair 0, type 0.3) are held fixed, so only the categorical noise level varies. Enabled terms are the positive-weight terms half and type; endpoint, orientation and pair are zero-weight and inactive, and no anchors are present. Source layout_score 8.912 is not a generated-score forecast; comparison is against the declared R06 parent (mean_pic50 7.675, best 8.049) and matched unguided controls.
